$comment: Launch profiles for Drover (launch.start, the Launch view, drover_launch). argv is appended after the engine binary (a leading ~/ in an argument is the launching host's home); env is merged into the child env. The profile marked default is used when a launch names none. Models are aliases the claude and codex CLIs accept, and for hermes a model id its configured provider takes (none listed: its config.yaml model.default). tmuxSession is where a tmux launch opens its window when it names no session; tmuxSessions and cwdSuggestions fill the Launch form's suggestions. To change any of this, copy the file and point DROVER_PROFILES at the copy (a leading ~/ is your home).

profiles.label: default permissions (the agent asks before it acts; Drover shows the dialog)
plan mode (reads and plans, asks before it changes anything)
skip permission prompts (only where you trust the agent with the machine)
read-only sandbox (reads and plans, changes nothing)
workspace-write sandbox, asks when it needs more
codex without approvals or sandbox (only where you trust the agent with the machine)
hermes TUI (your config.yaml model; in tmux it asks before a dangerous command and Drover shows the approval; headless follows approvals.single_query_mode, deny by default)
hermes classic REPL (turns sent from Drover run but are not drawn in its window)
hermes without approval prompts (only where you trust the agent with the machine)

credentials.$comment: Credential pool for Claude launches (core/credpool.js). Each entry maps child env vars to $NAME references resolved from the daemon's process.env at launch time; a value is never written here, and an entry whose variables are unset is reported available:false and never picked. default: auto | none | a pool id. auto picks the lowest active/weight ratio under maxConcurrent, skips entries throttled in the last 2 minutes, round robin on ties. Empty, every launch inherits the daemon environment. Example of two accounts with separate quotas: [{ "id": "main", "label": "main account", "env": { "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_MAIN" }, "weight": 2, "maxConcurrent": 12 }, { "id": "second", "label": "second account", "env": { "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_SECOND" }, "weight": 1 }]
